description:
What was sent and what came back, newest first — the answer to "did my webhook fire?". One record per attempt, so an event delivered on its third try appears three times. A null response_status means nothing answered at all (DNS, refused connection, timeout), which is what tells a wrong URL apart from a handler that threw. Filter with status: "failed" to see only what broke.

Requires scope `webhooks:read`.

end.description: Only attempts at or before this time.

ending_before.description: Cursor from a previous response. Fetches the page before it. Not with starting_after.

event.description: An event id. These are camelCase because they are the literal `event` field of the JSON we POST, not API fields.

start.description: Only attempts at or after this time.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Fetches the page after it.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook delivery attempts
